cli_validation: Author-led complete capture reproduced; independent actual corrected CLI exit 0 and complete output reproduced by parent

source_orientation.title: OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Business Conduct (2018)
source_orientation.scope: Primary source orientation for actual/potential impacts, buyer relationship and severity/likelihood; not a prescribed scoring model or legal finding

checks: Explicit caller ordinal anchors with no multiplication or default country/sector scores
Supported selected impacts distinct from proxies, allegations and irrelevant/missing evidence
Severity ties and unknown likelihood/relationship remain visible
Actual occurrence likelihood null; unknown observation date null plus gap distinct from source access
Empty/incomplete screening cannot establish no risk or low risk
Owned follow-ups and new open professional review preserve prior gates
No aggregate supplier risk, physical metrics, misconduct finding, contact or procurement approval
Invalid anchors/ratings/source references/context/dates reject full screening register
Original supplier entities, history, assumptions and gaps preserved
Full author-led and corrected independent proposal reproduction

independent_case.initial_issue: Mandatory observed_date required a substitute for undated source
independent_case.correction: Explicit null observation date and gap; access metadata remains separate
independent_case.rerun: Raw source unchanged, unknown severity withheld, labour proxy unranked and review open
independent_case.remaining: Geographic/source-period applicability contradictions remain human review; one scenario is not general reliability

limitations: Supplied source-fitness and relationship/severity judgments are not independently authenticated
Selected supplier/site/topic triage only, not complete due diligence or legal compliance
Broader methods, low-carbon procurement options, organizational evaluation and release gates remain
